10000002.name: Kamisato Ayaka
10000002.title: Frostflake Heron
10000002.description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

10000003.name: Jean
10000003.title: Dandelion Knight
10000003.description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

10000005.name: Aether
10000005.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

10000006.name: Lisa
10000006.title: Witch of Purple Rose
10000006.description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

10000014.name: Barbara
10000014.title: Shining Idol
10000014.description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

10000015.name: Kaeya
10000015.title: Frostwind Swordsman
10000015.description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

10000016.name: Diluc
10000016.title: Dark Side of Dawn
10000016.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

10000020.name: Razor
10000020.title: Wolf Boy
10000020.description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

10000021.name: Amber
10000021.title: Gliding Champion
10000021.description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

10000022.name: Venti
10000022.title: Windborne Bard
10000022.description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

10000023.name: Xiangling
10000023.title: Exquisite Delicacy
10000023.description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

10000024.name: Beidou
10000024.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
10000024.description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

10000025.name: Xingqiu
10000025.title: Juvenile Galant
10000025.description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

10000026.name: Xiao
10000026.title: Vigilant Yaksha
10000026.description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

10000027.name: Ningguang
10000027.title: Eclipsing Star
10000027.description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

10000029.name: Klee
10000029.title: Fleeing Sunlight
10000029.description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

10000030.name: Zhongli
10000030.title: Vago Mundo
10000030.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

10000031.name: Fischl
10000031.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
10000031.description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

10000032.name: Bennett
10000032.title: Trial by Fire
10000032.description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

10000033.name: Tartaglia
10000033.title: Childe
10000033.description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

10000034.name: Noelle
10000034.title: Chivalric Blossom
10000034.description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

10000035.name: Qiqi
10000035.title: Icy Resurrection
10000035.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

10000036.name: Chongyun
10000036.title: Frozen Ardor
10000036.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

10000037.name: Ganyu
10000037.title: Plenilune Gaze
10000037.description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

10000038.name: Albedo
10000038.title: Kreideprinz
10000038.description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

10000039.name: Diona
10000039.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
10000039.description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

10000041.name: Mona
10000041.title: Astral Reflection
10000041.description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

10000042.name: Keqing
10000042.title: Driving Thunder
10000042.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

10000043.name: Sucrose
10000043.title: Harmless Sweetie
10000043.description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

10000044.name: Xinyan
10000044.title: Blazing Riff
10000044.description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

10000045.name: Rosaria
10000045.title: Thorny Benevolence
10000045.description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

10000046.name: Hu Tao
10000046.title: Fragrance in Thaw
10000046.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

10000047.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
10000047.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
10000047.description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

10000048.name: Yanfei
10000048.title: Wise Innocence
10000048.description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

10000049.name: Yoimiya
10000049.title: Frolicking Flames
10000049.description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

10000050.name: Thoma
10000050.title: Protector From Afar
10000050.description: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

10000051.name: Eula
10000051.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
10000051.description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

10000052.name: Raiden Shogun
10000052.title: Plane of Euthymia
10000052.description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

10000053.name: Sayu
10000053.title: Mujina Ninja
10000053.description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems to be lacking sleep.

10000054.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
10000054.title: Pearl of Wisdom
10000054.description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

10000055.name: Gorou
10000055.title: Canine Warrior
10000055.description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

10000056.name: Kujou Sara
10000056.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
10000056.description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

10000057.name: Arataki Itto
10000057.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
10000057.description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

10000058.name: Yae Miko
10000058.title: Astute Amusement
10000058.description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

10000059.name: Shikanoin Heizou
10000059.title: Analytical Harmony
10000059.description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

10000060.name: Yelan
10000060.title: Valley Orchid
10000060.description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

10000061.name: Kirara
10000061.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
10000061.description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

10000062.name: Aloy
10000062.title: Savior From Another World
10000062.description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

10000063.name: Shenhe
10000063.title: Lonesome Transcendence
10000063.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

10000064.name: Yun Jin
10000064.title: Stage Lucida
10000064.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

10000065.name: Kuki Shinobu
10000065.title: Mender of Tribulations
10000065.description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader - Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

10000066.name: Kamisato Ayato
10000066.title: Pillar of Fortitude
10000066.description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

10000067.name: Collei
10000067.title: Sprout of Rebirth
10000067.description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

10000068.name: Dori
10000068.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
10000068.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

10000069.name: Tighnari
10000069.title: Verdant Strider
10000069.description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

10000070.name: Nilou
10000070.title: Dance of Lotuslight
10000070.description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

10000071.name: Cyno
10000071.title: Judicator of Secrets
10000071.description: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

10000072.name: Candace
10000072.title: Golden Vow
10000072.description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

10000073.name: Nahida
10000073.title: Physic of Purity
10000073.description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

10000074.name: Layla
10000074.title: Fantastical Evening Star
10000074.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

10000075.name: Wanderer
10000075.title: Eons Adrift
10000075.description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

10000076.name: Faruzan
10000076.title: Enigmatic Machinist
10000076.description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

10000077.name: Yaoyao
10000077.title: Burgeoning Grace
10000077.description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

10000078.name: Alhaitham
10000078.title: Admonishing Instruction
10000078.description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

10000079.name: Dehya
10000079.title: Flame-Mane
10000079.description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

10000080.name: Mika
10000080.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
10000080.description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

10000081.name: Kaveh
10000081.title: Empyrean Reflection
10000081.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

10000082.name: Baizhu
10000082.title: Beyond Mortality
10000082.description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

10000083.name: Lynette
10000083.title: Elegance in the Shadows
10000083.description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

10000084.name: Lyney
10000084.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
10000084.description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

10000085.name: Freminet
10000085.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
10000085.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

10000086.name: Wriothesley
10000086.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
10000086.description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

10000087.name: Neuvillette
10000087.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
10000087.description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

10000088.name: Charlotte
10000088.title: Lens of Verity
10000088.description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

10000089.name: Furina
10000089.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
10000089.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

10000090.name: Chevreuse
10000090.title: Executor of Justice
10000090.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

10000091.name: Navia
10000091.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
10000091.description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

10000092.name: Gaming
10000092.title: Leonine Vanguard
10000092.description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.
10000092.affiliation: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency

10000093.name: Xianyun
10000093.title: Passerine Herald
10000093.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

10000094.name: Chiori
10000094.title: The Thundering Seamstress
10000094.description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

10000095.name: Sigewinne
10000095.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
10000095.description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

10000096.name: Arlecchino
10000096.title: Dire Balemoon
10000096.description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

10000097.name: Sethos
10000097.title: Wisdom's Measure
10000097.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

10000098.name: Clorinde
10000098.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
10000098.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

10000099.name: Emilie
10000099.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
10000099.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

10000100.name: Kachina
10000100.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
10000100.description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

10000101.name: Kinich
10000101.title: Turnfire Hunt
10000101.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

10000102.name: Mualani
10000102.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
10000102.description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

10000103.name: Xilonen
10000103.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
10000103.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

10000104.name: Chasca
10000104.title: Skyborne Arbiter
10000104.description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

10000105.name: Ororon
10000105.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
10000105.description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

10000106.name: Mavuika
10000106.title: Night-Igniting Flame
10000106.description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

10000107.name: Citlali
10000107.title: Obsidian Opalstar
10000107.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

10000108.name: Lan Yan
10000108.title: Spring Woven From Jade
10000108.description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

10000109.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
10000109.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
10000109.description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

10000110.name: Iansan
10000110.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
10000110.description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

10000111.name: Varesa
10000111.title: Strength in Serenity
10000111.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

10000112.name: Escoffier
10000112.title: Tasteful Excellence
10000112.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

10000113.name: Ifa
10000113.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
10000113.description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

10000114.name: Skirk
10000114.title: Void Star
10000114.description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

10000115.name: Dahlia
10000115.title: Ode and Oblation
10000115.description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

10000116.name: Ineffa
10000116.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
10000116.description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

10000117.name: Manekin
10000117.description: A Manekin gifted to you and Paimon by a witch who uses the pseudonym "Octavia." They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.

10000118.name: Manekina
10000118.description: A Manekin gifted to you and Paimon by a witch who uses the pseudonym "Octavia." They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.

10000119.name: Lauma
10000119.title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
10000119.description: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

10000120.name: Flins
10000120.title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
10000120.description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

10000121.name: Aino
10000121.title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
10000121.description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

10000122.name: Nefer
10000122.title: Secret Beneath the Sands
10000122.description: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

10000123.name: Durin
10000123.title: "The Undying Fire"
10000123.description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

10000124.name: Jahoda
10000124.title: Windthreading Shadow
10000124.description: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).

10000125.name: Columbina
10000125.title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
10000125.description: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

10000126.name: Zibai
10000126.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
10000126.description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

10000127.name: Illuga
10000127.title: Nightmare's Burning Heart
10000127.description: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

10000128.name: Varka
10000128.title: Knight of Boreas
10000128.description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

10000129.name: Lohen
10000129.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
10000129.description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

10000130.name: Linnea
10000130.title: Augur of Wonders
10000130.description: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

10000132.name: Prune
10000132.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
10000132.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

10000133.name: Sandrone
10000133.title: Mirrored Analysis
10000133.description: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

10000140.name: Vodyanitsa
10000140.title: Lingering Siren-Song
10000140.description: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe and a Water Imp who has parted from her kin.

10000143.name: Vesna
10000143.title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
10000143.description: Commander of the Druzhna and the Tsaritsa's keen blade.

10000148.name: Alyosha
10000148.title: Swift-Striding Hound
10000148.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

10000150.name: Odette
10000150.title: Swirling Snow
10000150.description: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.
